## Jolt Translations

### Structure

Since these are global to all of Jolt, string keys _will_ matter.
Try to group them within the existing structure.

__Make sure you aren't duplicating an existing entry!__

### ID Key Sections

- `command.*` - Interaction commands, usually for buttons
- `error.*` - Errors
- `footer.*` - Footer of the web portal
- `label.*` - Input/section labels
- `lists.*` - Lists-specific messages
- `login.*` - Login-specific messages
- `marketing.*` - Marketing copy registration
- `orderForm.*` - Order form-specific messages
- `postRegistration.*` - Post registration-specific messages
- `product.*` - Product titles
- `registration.*` - Registration-specific messages
- `reporting.*` - Reporting-specific messages
- `sensors.*` - Sensors-specific messages
- `subscription.*` - Subscription-specific messages

Within these sections, you can add subsections for more specificity if needed.
